(Japanese: ''' マスタークラスへの試練！どうするセレナ！？''' ''The Master Class Trial! What Will You Do, Serena!?'') is the 109th episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', and the 908th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on February 25, 2016 and in the United States on June 4, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Our heroes are in Fleurrh City for Serena’s next Pokémon Showcase, where she’s hoping to win her third Princess Key and qualify for the Master Class. She’s going up against a hometown favorite named Amelia, who puts on an excellent show. Serena and her Pokémon are more concerned with having fun than being perfect—and in the end, she wins! Serena accidentally overhears Amelia complaining to Showcase judge Palermo about her loss. Afterward, Palermo tells Serena that she doesn’t yet have what it takes to be Kalos Queen. Serena ponders that as our heroes head for the next Pokémon Showcase in Gloire City, where she’ll compete in the Master Class! ==Plot== {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrive in [[Fleurrh City]], where {{an|Serena}} hopes to win her next {{pkmn|Showcase}} in order to obtain her third and final {{DL|Pokémon Showcase|Princess Key}}. While walking along the sidewalk, they see a crowd gathering to cheer on a girl named {{OBP|Amelia|XY109}}. Serena feels a little intimidated as Amelia walks past without even acknowledging anyone. Later, as they eat dinner, Serena is still too nervous to even eat. The next day, Serena is feeling more confident in herself and assures her friends that she is ready to perform. {{TP|Clemont|Bunnelby}} and {{TP|Clemont|Chespin}} wish good luck to {{TP|Serena|Sylveon}}, which she thanks them for. Next, Serena enters the dressing room. Amelia arrogantly moves in front of Serena and says that she must go first. Meanwhile, [[Palermo]], a former [[Kalos Queen]] and well-known producer, arrives at the Showcase as a guest judge in her limousine. A moustached man anxiously approaches Palermo, asking if she will mentor Amelia, explaining that Amelia belongs to a very respected family and donors of the Showcase in Fleurrh City. Palermo tells him that she will judge with her own eyes. [[File:XY109 Concetta VS Serena VS Kazalie.png|thumb|left|250px|Concetta, Serena, and Kazalie]] Ash, {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{an|Clemont}}, Bunnelby, Chespin, and {{an|Bonnie}} are in the audience for the event. [[Monsieur Pierre]] hosts the Showcase performance. He has his {{p|Klefki}} show the Princess Key to the audience. Monsieur Pierre explains to the audience that to win the first stage, the {{pkmn|Performer}} must attract the most {{p|Rhyhorn}}. Serena is in the first round. Her competitors are [[Concetta]] who uses her {{p|Scraggy}} and [[Kazalie]] with her {{p|Lilligant}}. The Rhyhorn are immediately attracted to Serena. Serena is surrounded by Rhyhorn and some even start licking her. Kazalie has her Lilligant use {{m|Sweet Scent}}, which attracts some Rhyhorn towards her. Serena sees a lone Rhyhorn outside of the herd. She runs towards the lone Rhyhorn. She pets it on its head and then rides it back to where the rest of the Rhyhorn are. After the timer is finished, Monsieur Pierre declares Serena the winner. After a few more rounds, Monsieur Pierre starts the last round of the first stage. When Monsieur Pierre announces Amelia's name, the crowd cheers. She has her {{Shiny}} {{p|Dragonair}} and {{p|Espeon}} use {{m|Attract}} on the Rhyhorn who follow her Pokémon. She is soon declared the winner. Monsieur Pierre announces that the next round will be the Freestyle Performance. Serena is seen with her Pokémon. Her Sylveon is quite nervous for the performance, but Serena feeds Sylveon, {{TP|Serena|Pancham}}, and {{TP|Serena|Braixen}} some [[Poké Puff]]s, which eases all of their nerves. Amelia goes first in the final stage of the Showcase. She starts by having her Espeon and Dragonair jump in the air and then her Espeon uses {{m|Psychic}} and Dragonair uses {{m|Dragon Dance}}. Dragonair dances in circles around sparkly purple glimmers of light and then she commands Espeon and Dragonair to use Attract. Hearts are sent towards the audience, alluring the spectators. Espeon follows up with a {{m|Rain Dance}} and Amelia walks on Dragonair's tail. She then leaps off and commands Dragonair to use {{m|Ice Beam}} which freezes the rain. Espeon uses {{m|Hyper Voice}} which showers the crowd in a dazzle of the delicate snowflakes, concluding Amelia’s performance. Serena performs next, and she starts out by having Braixen use {{m|Flamethrower}} while Serena, Pancham, and Sylveon dance around the circle of fire. Sylveon uses {{m|Fairy Wind}} which spreads the circling fire into a dazzling display in the sky. Pancham jumps high off of Sylveon's bows. Pancham punches the ground and uses {{m|Stone Edge}} which collides with the fire and makes a shower of sparkles. Serena and her Pokémon dance around the bright rays of the light falling to the ground. Observing closely, Palermo is mildly impressed by Serena's performance. Next, Pancham uses Stone Edge, which Braixen and Sylveon jump on. Braixen uses {{m|Fire Blast}} which, when hit by Sylveon's {{m|Swift}}, creates a row of sparkles for the audience. Serena is now finished with her performance. With all five performances completed, Monsieur Pierre asks the audience to vote for the winner by using their Glow Casters. After the results are in, Monsieur Pierre announces Serena as the winner. Serena receives her third Princess Key, qualifying her for the Master Class. Back at the local [[Pokémon Center]], Serena videocalls her good friend {{an|Shauna}} to inform her of the news. Shauna reveals that she’s being practicing a lot as well and looks forward to the upcoming Master Class. Cutting the call short, Bonnie calls Serena over because Clemont has prepared a feast for them to celebrate, which the group and their Pokémon enjoy. Having eaten, Serena prepares to brush her Pokémon when she realizes she forgot her brush at the Showcase theater. When she picks it up, she sees Amelia begging Palermo to train her. Palermo tells Amelia that she lost as judged by the audience and should be doing something more productive. After Amelia leaves in a huff, Palermo beckons Serena over. Palermo asks if Serena was satisfied with her performance. She tells Palermo that she thought it was fun. Palermo tells her that there is something she definitely lacks and if she does not find out what it is, she will not be able to defeat {{an|Aria}}. That night, Serena ponders what it might be. The next morning, the group learns that the Pokémon Showcase Master Class will be held in [[Gloire City]], so they make that their next destination. ==Major events== [[File:Serena Fleurrh Princess Key.png|thumb|250px|Serena holding the Fleurrh Princess Key]] * {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrive in [[Fleurrh City]]. * {{an|Serena}} enters the Fleurrh {{pkmn|Showcase}} Rookie Class and wins, earning her third [[Princess Key]] and thus qualifying for the Master Class. * Serena meets [[Palermo]] for the first time. * Serena learns that the Pokémon Showcase Master Class will take place in [[Gloire City]]. {{animeevents|XY}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Kazalie]] * [[Shulin]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== [[File:Pokémon Quiz XY109.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon Quiz]] * {{Ash}} * {{an|Serena}} * {{an|Clemont}} * {{an|Bonnie}} * {{an|Shauna}} (video call) * [[Monsieur Pierre]] * [[Palermo]] * [[Alouette]] * [[Clarice]] * [[Concetta]] * [[Sara Lee]] * {{OBP|Amelia|XY109}} * [[Kazalie]] * [[Shulin]] * {{pkmn|Performer}}s ===Pokémon=== [[File:WTP XY109.png|thumb|200px|Who's That Pokémon?]] [[Who's That Pokémon?]]: {{p|Espeon}} ''(US and international)''
